documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: An identity document used for identity verification where accepted.
requirements: Provide an Aadhaar number or card only when requested by the relevant authority.
Check whether alternative identity documents are accepted.
documents.notes: Do not assume Aadhaar is mandatory for every scheme.

documents.name: PAN Card
documents.description: A Permanent Account Number document used for tax and certain financial transactions.
requirements: Provide PAN details when required for the specific service.
documents.notes: PAN is not required for every welfare scheme.

documents.name: Voter ID
documents.description: An electoral photo identity document.
requirements: Provide the document if accepted by the relevant authority.
documents.notes: Check the authority's accepted identity-document list.

documents.name: Passport
documents.description: An official travel and identity document.
requirements: Submit it only when accepted or requested.
documents.notes: A passport is not a universal requirement for government benefits.

documents.name: Driving Licence
documents.description: A document authorising a person to drive specified motor vehicles.
requirements: Use it as identity proof only where the authority accepts it.
documents.notes: Driving licence eligibility and application rules depend on the relevant transport authority.

documents.name: Birth Certificate
documents.description: An official record of birth.
requirements: Provide the certificate or an accepted alternative if requested.
documents.notes: Issuing authority and correction procedures vary by location.

documents.name: Address Proof
documents.description: A document accepted as evidence of a person's residential address.
requirements: Use a document from the authority's accepted list.
Check whether the document must be recent.
documents.notes: Accepted documents vary by service.

documents.name: Domicile or Residence Certificate
documents.description: A certificate used to establish residence or domicile under applicable rules.
requirements: Application form
Residence evidence
Identity proof
Other documents required by the issuing authority
documents.notes: Eligibility periods and supporting evidence differ between states.

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.description: A certificate issued by an authorised authority to establish income for specified purposes.
requirements: Application form
Identity proof
Residence evidence, if required
Income-related evidence requested by the authority
documents.notes: Income calculation periods and accepted evidence vary by scheme.

documents.name: EWS Certificate
documents.description: A certificate used to establish eligibility under applicable Economically Weaker Section rules.
requirements: Application form
Income and asset evidence
Identity and residence evidence
Other evidence specified by the issuing authority
documents.notes: EWS rules are not interchangeable with every income-based welfare scheme.

documents.name: BPL or Poverty-Related Proof
documents.description: Evidence used by certain programmes to identify eligible households under their rules.
requirements: Use the household or eligibility record accepted by the specific programme.
documents.notes: A BPL card or status is not a universal requirement for all welfare schemes.

documents.name: Caste Certificate
documents.description: An official certificate establishing caste or community status under applicable rules.
requirements: Application form
Identity and residence evidence
Community-related supporting evidence requested by the authority
documents.notes: The issuing authority and applicable certificate format depend on the state and purpose.

documents.name: Scheduled Tribe Certificate
documents.description: An official certificate establishing Scheduled Tribe status where applicable.
requirements: Application form
Identity and residence evidence
Other community evidence specified by the issuing authority
documents.notes: Verify the accepted certificate format and issuing authority.

documents.name: OBC Certificate
documents.description: A certificate establishing Other Backward Classes status for specified purposes.
requirements: Application form
Identity and residence evidence
Community-related supporting documents, if requested
documents.notes: Some purposes require a specific certificate format or additional non-creamy-layer evidence.

documents.name: Non-Creamy Layer Certificate
documents.description: A certificate used for applicable OBC non-creamy-layer eligibility.
requirements: Community certificate, if required
Income and other evidence specified by the issuing authority
documents.notes: Validity and rules depend on the purpose and issuing authority.

documents.name: Disability Certificate
documents.description: An authorised certificate documenting disability for applicable services and benefits.
requirements: Application through the authorised process
Medical assessment and supporting records as requested
documents.notes: The applicable disability assessment and certification process must be verified.

documents.name: UDID Card
documents.description: A Unique Disability ID card associated with the applicable disability certification process.
requirements: Follow the official UDID application and certification process.
documents.notes: Check whether a particular scheme accepts or specifically requires UDID.

documents.name: Medical Certificate or Records
documents.description: Medical evidence requested for certain health, disability, or treatment-related services.
requirements: Obtain the specific report or certificate requested by the authority.
documents.notes: A general medical certificate may not replace a scheme-specific medical report.

documents.name: Educational Marksheet
documents.description: A record of examination results issued by an educational board or institution.
requirements: Provide the relevant examination marksheet or accepted digital record.
documents.notes: The required examination and year depend on the application.

documents.name: Study or Bonafide Certificate
documents.description: A certificate from an educational institution confirming enrolment or student status.
requirements: Request the certificate from the relevant institution.
documents.notes: Some programmes require a specific institution-issued format.

documents.name: Transfer Certificate
documents.description: A document issued by an educational institution when a student leaves or transfers.
requirements: Request the document from the previous institution where applicable.
documents.notes: Not required for every scholarship or government scheme.

documents.name: Bank Passbook or Account Proof
documents.description: Evidence of a bank account, sometimes requested for direct benefit transfers.
requirements: Provide the account details and proof requested by the scheme.
Check whether account-holder name or other conditions apply.
documents.notes: Do not share PINs, passwords, or OTPs when applying.

documents.name: Ration Card
documents.description: A household document used for specified public distribution and welfare services.
requirements: Provide the applicable household ration-card record if requested.
documents.notes: Ration-card rules and eligibility differ by state and programme.

documents.name: Marriage Certificate
documents.description: An official record of marriage where registered under applicable law.
requirements: Follow the relevant registration authority's process.
documents.notes: Other evidence may be accepted for certain purposes; verify the specific rules.

documents.name: Farmer or Land-Related Records
documents.description: Records used to verify agricultural activity, landholding, or farmer registration where required.
requirements: Provide the records specifically requested by the agricultural authority.
documents.notes: Land ownership is not necessarily the only way to qualify for every farmer programme.

documents.name: Employment or Skill Certificate
documents.description: Evidence of employment status, training, or qualifications for specified applications.
requirements: Provide the certificate or registration details requested by the programme.
documents.notes: Requirements depend on the programme and training provider.

documents.name: Affidavit or Self-Declaration
documents.description: A formal declaration used where the relevant authority permits or requires it.
requirements: Use the prescribed declaration format, if one exists.
documents.notes: An affidavit cannot replace an official certificate when the authority requires one.
